第2091章 翻盘的机会来了（第1页）
翻盘的机会来了（翻盘的机会来了（第22页）两人全都一愣，不可思议地看着冷寂：“冷哥，你手里有特里普的把柄？”
不可能吧？连港督的把柄都能拿到，那他们这棋下的是不是过于厉害了？冷寂没有回答两人的问题，而是端起酒杯浅喝了一小口：“今天晚上不要喝多了，省得耽误正事。”
狄子扬回头看了看门口的位置低声道：“冷哥，那我们是不是得好好准备一下？”
冷寂三个人的住所是个普通的小院，当初为了出入方便所才找到的这里。
毕竟港城的楼房住的人太多了，苏灿要是布置眼线那简直就是手到擒来的事，所以冷寂果断选择了这种小院子。
四面八方皆是逃生之路，一旦出事，他们能平安离开的可能性最大。
咚咚咚……敲门声响起的时候，冷寂三人也刚刚放下碗筷。
三人彼此对视了一眼，屠强最先起身走过去喊了一声：“谁呀？”
与此同时，冷寂和狄子扬迅速地起身隐藏了起来，拿出手枪紧盯着大门的方向。
一旦有异样，他们会第一时间做出反应。
而隐藏在屋顶上的手下，则第一时间往大门处看过去，发现大门外确实只有一个人。
外面传来一个低沉还算熟悉的声音：“是我……我是陈志康……”
屠强躲在墙的拐角处，手里已经掏出了手枪，听着外面的声音他冷声道：“你带谁过来了？”
麻烦你快开开门，我有非常紧急的事。”
这声音一直用力地压着，生怕别人听到一样。
陈志康说这些话的时候，一直左右警惕地打量着，他现在倒是不怕冷寂他们，他最怕的是被苏灿他们盯梢。
一旦他们也来到这里，那自己翻盘的机会可能就没有了。

冷寂他们第一个想到的，就是自己带他们来的。
好在他左看右看，也没看到有人盯梢自己。
屋顶上的手下一跃而下，落在了陈志康的身后，把陈志康给吓了一哆嗦。
说完对着陈志康从上到下搜了一遍，确定没什么问题才跟里面的屠强道：“没带东西和人，可以开门。”
屠强一听这才打开了大门，陈志康小心翼翼地回头看了看，说不担心是假的。
外面漆黑一片，也不知道自己那个表弟江尚风藏好了没有？他的身家性命，以及自己老婆孩子一家人的未来可全都捏在他手里了。

Chapter 2091 The opportunity for a comeback has come (page 1)
The opportunity for a comeback has come (The opportunity for a comeback has come (page 22)) Both of them were stunned and looked at Leng Ji in disbelief: "Brother Leng, do you have something against Tripp?"
Impossible? They can even get the handle on the Hong Kong Governor, so are their moves too powerful? Leng Ji did not answer the two people's questions, but picked up the wine glass and took a sip: "Don't drink too much tonight, so as not to delay the business."
Di Ziyang looked back at the door and whispered: "Brother Leng, do we have to prepare well?"
The residence of Leng Jie and the three of them was an ordinary small courtyard, which they found for the convenience of entry and exit.
After all, there are too many people living in the buildings in Hong Kong City. It would be easy for Su Can to arrange an informant, so Leng Ji decisively chose this small courtyard.
There are escape routes in all directions. If something happens, they have the best chance of leaving safely.
Dong Dong Dong... When the knock on the door rang, Leng Ji and the other three had just put down their dishes.
The three of them looked at each other. Tu Qiang was the first to get up and walked over and shouted: "Who is it?"
At the same time, Leng Ji and Di Ziyang quickly stood up and hid, taking out their pistols and staring in the direction of the door.
If something unusual happens, they will respond immediately.
The men hiding on the roof immediately looked at the gate and found that there was indeed only one person outside the gate.
A low and familiar voice came from outside: "It's me... I'm Chen Zhikang..."
Tu Qiang hid at the corner of the wall, with a pistol already drawn in his hand. Listening to the sounds outside, he said coldly: "Who did you bring here?"
Please open the door quickly, I have something very urgent. "
He kept suppressing his voice for fear that others would hear it.
When Chen Zhikang said these words, he kept looking around cautiously. He was not afraid of Leng Ji and the others now. What he was most afraid of was being watched by Su Can and the others.
Once they come here, their chance of making a comeback may be gone.
The first thing Leng Ji and the others thought of was that he had brought them here.
Fortunately, he looked left and right and didn't see anyone following him.
The man on the roof jumped down and landed behind Chen Zhikang, making Chen Zhikang tremble.
After saying that, he searched Chen Zhikang from top to bottom, and after making sure there was nothing wrong, he said to Tu Qiang inside: "You can open the door if you don't have anything or anyone with you."
When Tu Qiang heard this, he opened the door. Chen Zhikang looked back carefully and said that he was lying if he said he was not worried.
It's pitch dark outside, and I don't know if my cousin Jiang Shangfeng is hidden? His wealth, life, and the future of his wife, children, and family are all in his hands.
